messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: Ggplot and interactive charts
parts:
One of the examples for the tkexamp function in the TeachingDemos
package uses ggplot2 graphics. There the interaction is via Tk
widgets, but you can still dynamically change attributes of the graph.

Other interactive tools can be developed, you just need to find the
mapping between the device coordinates and the coordinates of the
points (there are a couple of other functions in the TeachingDemos
package and others that do this for base graphics). The important
information is probably in the plot object.
